title: Fourier coefficients under cube restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $f$ be a real-valued function on that cube, and let $S$ and $T$ be finite sets of coordinates in $J$ and its complement, respectively. Take the Fourier coefficient indexed by $T$ of the function of the fixed outside signs whose values are the Fourier coefficient indexed by $S$ of the restriction of $f$ to the free signs in $J$. This equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ indexed by the union of $S$ and $T$, viewed as coordinate sets in the full cube.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$f$ is a real-valued function on the full sign cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates in $J$
$T$ is a finite set of coordinates outside $J$
